messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered (2480001234) — EU region: embed-eu-prod showing sustained 5xx + p95 latency spike. Count: 3/min over 5m. Escalation to #incidents and paging @matt_oncall.

matt_oncall: Ack — joining bridge now. Initial plan: throttle canary rollout, failover to smaller model if needed.

ben_eng: On the bridge. Quick check: eu-dedicated-02 GPU pool reporting OOM during KV cache warmup for redwood-embed-v2-canary. Stack shows kernel alloc failures around transformer kernel.

maria_sre: Any user-facing errors? Need list for comms.

support_lead: Notified support triage. So far 3 customers impacted with transient 5xx: ACME, Finly, Pixio. Logged customer cases and set priority to P2. Updating status page now.

matt_oncall: Mitigation applied: scaled eu-dedicated-02 by +2 nodes (cmd: `infractl pool scale --pool eu-dedicated-02 --delta 2`), disabled kv prewarm for the canary (`model.config.kv_prewarm=false`), and routed ~40% traffic to `redwood-embed-v1-stable`. Latency trending down.

ben_eng: Adding detail: recent runtime kernel selector change (2026-03-15) may choose a new kernel path that allocs more memory for certain sequence lengths. Repro locally on a medium test VM with the failing workload.

jess_prod: Alert/ops note: we got repeated pages during autoscaler activity. Proposal: enrich pager with `model_kv_evictions` and `alloc-failure` signals and require sustained 5xx > 1.5% over 10m before pager. Also add an annotation so incident-bot suppresses repeat pages while autoscaler is actively scaling.

maria_sre: Postmortem scheduling: suggest tomorrow 09:30 PT. Invite list: eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-sre, customer success.

matt_oncall: Agreed. Recording action items in thread: 1) Ben — investigate OOM root cause and confirm kernel regression, rollback patch if needed — due 24h. 2) Jess — add `model_kv_evictions` to alerts and update pager threshold to sustained 10m signal — due 48h. 3) Maria — publish customer-impact summary and status page update — due 2h. 4) Matt — runbook for canary throttles and automatic fallback policy (include steps/commands) — due 72h.

ben_eng: Quick repro steps in case helpful: run `./tools/repro --model redwood-embed-v2-canary --seq 1024 --batch 4` and inspect `dmesg` + runtime logs. I can post a failing trace in the postmortem. If confirmed I'll open a revert PR.

jess_prod: Also following up: short-term paging tweak to reduce noise — increase suppression window to 10m for duplicate 5xx alarms on same model-instance pair. Long-term: include a composite signal that ignores transient autoscaler-induced gap when node join is in flight.

support_lead: Customer comms: I posted templated note to affected customers and linked internal case IDs. Will update when postmortem is available.

matt_oncall: Bridge: closing for now — service recovered -> degraded -> recovered; continuing with post-ops. Severity recorded as Sev2. Postmortem on calendar for tomorrow 09:30 PT.

incident-bot: Bridge closed (2480002890). Actions recorded. :white_check_mark:
